summary.text: Sherri Brantley is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 112 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sherri Brantley's career experience includes working as a math specialist.
Brantley took office representing Kansas House District 112 on January 13, 2025, succeeding Tory Marie Blew.
In the 2025–2026 session she was assigned to the House Education Committee and the Legislative Modernization Committee and served as vice chair of the K-12 Education Budget Committee.
